description: This file contains the implementation of the Decoder class which is responsible for decoding PNG image data, handling various interlace methods, filters, and pixel formats.

classes.name: Decoder
classes.description: A static class providing methods for PNG image data decoding, including handling interlaced and non-interlaced images, with filter reversal logic.

methods.name: GetBytesAndSamplesPerPixel
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes per pixel and samples per pixel based on the image header.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Main decoding function that processes decompressed PNG data according to the image's interlace method, applying filtering and pixel reconstruction.

methods.name: SamplesPerPixel
methods.description: Determines the number of samples per pixel based on the color type.

methods.name: BytesPerScanline
methods.description: Calculates the number of bytes in each scanline based on image width, bit depth, and samples per pixel.

methods.name: ReverseFilter
methods.description: Reverses the applied PNG filter for each byte to reconstruct the original pixel data.

methods.name: GetPaethValue
methods.description: Calculates the Paeth predictor value used in PNG filtering.
